subject: Important Update: Changes to Billing Schedule
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about some upcoming changes to our billing schedule. Starting next month, your billing cycle will shift to the 15th of each month. This adjustment will ensure a more convenient billing process for you. Please review your account details to ensure all information is up to date. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
